summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of correspondence from Petrobras regarding execution of a new Shareholders' Agreement with Shine I FIP, regulating shared control of the Company. The agreement becomes effective upon closing of a share transaction disclosed on April 20, 2026, subject to conditions precedent including judicial authorizations. Antitrust approvals have been obtained. Petrobras formalized its decision not to exercise pre-emptive or tag-along rights. Board approval is required for Braskem's execution as intervening consenting party. This corporate governance filing does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation; it updates shareholders on control arrangements.
